tools.name: check_public_launch
tools.description: Look up a product launch that FrontStat already tracks: its name, its rank on this week's or this month's launch board, its visibility score (0 to 100), and whether ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini recommend it for its buyer question, with the products they name instead. Returns a link to its public Front

tools.name: get_visibility
tools.description: Your latest FrontStat report: date, visibility score, whether each AI search engine recommends your product for your main buyer question and who it names instead, and for your buyer questions how many answers recommend you (X of Y) per assistant. Needs a FrontStat plan (Lite or Pro): send your dashb

tools.name: list_buyer_questions
tools.description: Each buyer question FrontStat asks the AI search engines about your market, with yes or no per engine: does the answer recommend your product. Needs a FrontStat plan (Lite or Pro): send your dashboard token as a Bearer token. Covers the domain on your subscription.

tools.name: who_wins_instead
tools.description: The products the AI search engines name instead of yours, and the sites they cite, each with how many answers it appears in, from your latest Pro report. Needs a FrontStat plan (Lite or Pro): send your dashboard token as a Bearer token. Covers the domain on your subscription.

tools.name: cited_sites
tools.description: The sites the AI search engines cite most when they answer your buyer questions, with how many answers cite each one, your own domain left out. These are the pages to get mentioned on. Needs a FrontStat plan (Lite or Pro): send your dashboard token as a Bearer token. Covers the domain on your subscr

tools.name: visibility_history
tools.description: One point per day for the last 30 days: your visibility score and how many answers recommend your product. Use it to see whether your changes moved AI search engines. Needs a FrontStat plan (Lite or Pro): send your dashboard token as a Bearer token. Covers the domain on your subscription.
